Chemistry and Biochemistry
Chemistry and Biochemistry
The Chemistry and Biochemistry department at UCSB is recognized globally for its innovative research across the full spectrum of chemical sciences, including materials, organic, inorganic, and biochemical disciplines. Our faculty includes two Nobel laureates and over 30 research-active professors who work closely with graduate students and postdoctoral researchers. Strong interdisciplinary collaboration is central to our mission, supported by affiliated research centers such as the Materials Research Laboratory and the California Nanosystems Institute.
Situated on the California coast with views of the Channel Islands and Santa Ynez Mountains, our department offers a dynamic environment ideal for scientific exploration. Research is supported by state-of-the-art facilities, including NMR spectrometers, X-ray crystallography, and advanced characterization tools. Consistently ranked among the top chemistry programs in the U.S., UCSB fosters a vibrant, innovative, and collaborative research culture.
